content:
Looking at the net, the six triangles in the middle strip form the band of side faces of the octahedron (it is a triangular antiprism band), while the top triangle and bottom triangle become the top and bottom faces.

**Folding the band:** Wrapping the strip of six triangles closes it up, so the left edge (4) joins the right edge (1). This forces the vertex identifications: the top-right vertex of the strip coincides with the top-left vertex (D ≡ A), and the bottom-right vertex coincides with the bottom-left vertex (H ≡ E).

**Folding the caps:** The top cap (with edge 3) folds onto the top face, so its apex coincides with the remaining top vertex (T ≡ C); hence edge 3 (A–T) meets edge 2 (C–D). The bottom cap (with edge x) folds onto the bottom face, so its apex coincides with the remaining bottom vertex (U ≡ F).
